title: Off Broadway Review: MEXODUS - Bored and Confused?

Musically and stylistically, it's built around live looping. For those of you who don't know what that is, that's when you play an instrument, you record it, and then it loops that phrase, and then you layer on another instrument, and you do that all live, and it's all coming through the sound system, and then you can sing on top of that. They have little pedals on the floor that you can start and stop the loops whenever you need to. These two performers are multi-instrumentalists.
